description: Green-panel allowlist for DS gate ratchet (Survivor #6). Files listed here run DS rules in FAIL mode instead of WARN. The list can only grow — adding a file is a one-way door. Used by ds-grep-gates.sh and (eventually) the ESLint overlay to ratchet WARN → FAIL file-by-file as panels migrate through PanelShell (Week 3+).
mechanism: On each gate run, a file in `files` is counted separately. If its current violation count exceeds zero, that gate FAILS for the file regardless of overall baseline. This is stricter than the baseline check because it accepts zero violations, not baseline-parity.
notes: Migrated files are expected to have ZERO chrome-gate violations (gradients, raw shadows, radius > 4 on panel chrome, magic layout literals). Adding a file with existing violations will fail CI immediately.

Order of addition follows the rollout in docs/ideation/2026-04-20-editor-chrome-ds-ideation.md: Week 3 PanelShell migrations add sidebar tabs one at a time; Week 5-6 inspector schema adds one section at a time.
Do NOT remove files from this list once added. If a migration regresses, fix the code — removing from the allowlist hides the regression.
